response.overview: Inspired by 17th-century Dutch still life paintings, where insects appear in the details, chewing fruit, eating leaves, and disrupting the scene, PILLAGE draws on what Harry Berger Jr. described as “caterpillage”: creeping life that quietly undermines the illusion of perfection the image tries to create.  Using a macro lens, the film looks at scenes that seem still and untouched. Up close, insects move, feed, and struggle. Beneath the calm surface, a constant fight for survival is taking place, revealing the hidden battles that sustain the illusion of stillness.
response.title: Pillage
